### 1. Architecture Overview
The request touches each repository’s Kubernetes runtime type registration pattern. All three systems follow the **Kubernetes `runtime.SchemeBuilder`/`AddToScheme` pattern**, ensuring their CRD types can be serialized/deserialized and composed into shared schemes.

- **Cilium** collects Kubernetes core, discovery, networking, and its own CRD schemes into a single package-level `runtime.SchemeBuilder`. `pkg/k8s/resource/scheme.go` defines `scheme := runtime.NewScheme()`, registers `corev1`, `discoveryv1`, `networkingv1`, and the Cilium API versions (`cilium.io/v2` and `/v2alpha1`), and exposes `AddToScheme = localSchemeBuilder.AddToScheme` so other components can plug into this composite scheme at will. The `init()` simply calls `utilruntime.Must(AddToScheme(scheme))` to eagerly register them when the package loads.
  
- **Gatekeeper** centralizes API registration via `apis/apis.go`, where `AddToSchemes runtime.SchemeBuilder` collects all subgroup registration functions. Each API package (e.g., `connection/v1alpha1` in `apis/addtoscheme_connection_v1alpha1.go`) appends its versioned `AddToScheme` to `AddToSchemes` in an `init()` block so that invoking `apis.AddToScheme(scheme)` registers every Gatekeeper API group at once.

- **External Secrets** uses controller-runtime’s `scheme.Builder` directly inside each API version (`apis/externalsecrets/v1/register.go` and `/v1beta1/register.go`). Each defines `SchemeGroupVersion`, creates `SchemeBuilder := &scheme.Builder{GroupVersion: SchemeGroupVersion}`, exposes `AddToScheme = SchemeBuilder.AddToScheme`, sets up reflection metadata for every resource (`ExternalSecret`, `ClusterExternalSecret`, `SecretStore`, `ClusterSecretStore`), and registers them in `init()` by calling `SchemeBuilder.Register(...)`.

### 2. Detailed Analysis

#### Cilium Scheme Registration
- File `pkg/k8s/resource/scheme.go` defines the package global `scheme` (`runtime.NewScheme()`) and aggregates the Go-typed `AddToScheme` functions (`corev1`, `discoveryv1`, `networkingv1`, `cilium_io/v2`, `cilium_io/v2alpha1`) into `localSchemeBuilder`. The exported `AddToScheme` alias allows other modules to register the same composite set in their own runtime scheme, and the `init()` ensures they are registered when `pkg/k8s/resource` is imported (`utilruntime.Must(AddToScheme(scheme))`). ([source](#pkg/k8s/resource/scheme.go))
  
- The generated fake client registration at `pkg/k8s/client/clientset/versioned/fake/register.go` constructs its own `runtime.Scheme`, initializes a codec factory, and builds a `SchemeBuilder` containing `ciliumv2.AddToScheme` and `ciliumv2alpha1.AddToScheme`. It exposes `AddToScheme` to allow composition with other client schemes and ensures the types are added in `init()` via `utilruntime.Must(AddToScheme(scheme))`. ([source](#pkg/k8s/client/clientset/versioned/fake/register.go))

#### Gatekeeper Global AddToScheme
- `apis/apis.go` declares `var AddToSchemes runtime.SchemeBuilder` and a convenience `func AddToScheme(s *runtime.Scheme) error` that invokes `AddToSchemes.AddToScheme(s)`. This central entry point means a single `AddToScheme` call picks up every API registration appended to `AddToSchemes`. ([source](#apis/apis.go))
  
- Each API package contributes its `AddToScheme` automatically. For example, `apis/addtoscheme_connection_v1alpha1.go` imports `github.com/open-policy-agent/gatekeeper/v3/apis/connection/v1alpha1` and appends `v1alpha1.AddToScheme` to the shared `AddToSchemes` slice inside an `init()` block. ([source](#apis/addtoscheme_connection_v1alpha1.go))

#### External Secrets Versioned Registration
- `apis/externalsecrets/v1/register.go` defines `Group = "external-secrets.io"` and `Version = "v1"`, creates `SchemeGroupVersion`, builds a `scheme.Builder`, and exposes `AddToScheme`. It sets up reflection metadata for `ExternalSecret`, `ClusterExternalSecret`, `SecretStore`, and `ClusterSecretStore`, and registers each resource and list type in the `init()` block via `SchemeBuilder.Register(...)`. ([source](#apis/externalsecrets/v1/register.go))

- The `v1beta1` counterpart follows the same layout (same group, version `v1beta1`, builder, metadata constants, and registration of the four resources in `init()`), meaning both versions can independently register with any runtime scheme by calling `AddToScheme`. ([source](#apis/externalsecrets/v1beta1/register.go))

### 3. Relevant Files

| Repo (KnowledgeId) | File Path | Why |
|-------------------|-----------|-----|
| `ab057f46-1b78-43c7-84b3-bc98fd2c5101` (Cilium) | `pkg/k8s/resource/scheme.go` | Defines composite `runtime.Scheme`, collects `corev1`, `discoveryv1`, `networkingv1`, and Cilium API `AddToScheme` functions, and exposes `AddToScheme` so everything can be registered together at package init ([source](#pkg/k8s/resource/scheme.go)). |
| `ab057f46-1b78-43c7-84b3-bc98fd2c5101` (Cilium) | `pkg/k8s/client/clientset/versioned/fake/register.go` | Generated fake client scheme registration; builds its own `scheme`, codec factory, and `SchemeBuilder` containing the Cilium API `AddToScheme` functions, and registers them during init ([source](#pkg/k8s/client/clientset/versioned/fake/register.go)). |
| `509a1028-e065-4f57-9af4-6513f3929680` (Gatekeeper) | `apis/apis.go` | Central hub declaring `AddToSchemes runtime.SchemeBuilder` and `AddToScheme(s *runtime.Scheme)` that delegates to every appended package-level registration, enabling global scheme composition ([source](#apis/apis.go)). |
| `509a1028-e065-4f57-9af4-6513f3929680` (Gatekeeper) | `apis/addtoscheme_connection_v1alpha1.go` | Demonstrates the append-to-global pattern: imports the connection API version and registers its `AddToScheme` with the global builder in `init()`, ensuring the connection CRDs participate in the aggregated scheme ([source](#apis/addtoscheme_connection_v1alpha1.go)). |
| `df9200e3-5480-4b75-9de1-40ee66ad6456` (External Secrets) | `apis/externalsecrets/v1/register.go` | Defines `SchemeBuilder`, reflection metadata for `ExternalSecret`/`ClusterExternalSecret`/`SecretStore`/`ClusterSecretStore`, exposes `AddToScheme`, and registers every type during `init()`, laying the groundwork for scheme composition ([source](#apis/externalsecrets/v1/register.go)). |
| `df9200e3-5480-4b75-9de1-40ee66ad6456` (External Secrets) | `apis/externalsecrets/v1beta1/register.go` | Same structure for version `v1beta1`: scheme metadata, builder, `AddToScheme`, and registration of the four resources, ensuring versioned registration capability ([source](#apis/externalsecrets/v1beta1/register.go)). |

This list covers every file referenced in the analysis across all relevant repositories and layers (scheme registration, API registration patterns, generated scheme scaffolding).
